Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (6+ years, with technical leadership expected) working on banking and lending software for credit unions, focused on modernizing legacy applications into modular, distributed designs. The role spans architecture, hands-on feature development, code review, mentoring, and production support rotation across backend, frontend, and database layers. The stack centers on a backend platform such as Java/Spring Boot, C#/.NET, Node.js, or Python, a modern frontend framework (Angular, React, or Vue), relational and document databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Progress), plus Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud CI/CD tooling.
